design_philosophy: Omotenashi (Japanese Hospitality). Minimalist, refined typography, washi paper textures, flat structural surfaces over heavy shadows. High visual impact with generous negative space.

spacing_and_layout.general: Use generous spacing. Containers must use p-6, p-8, or p-12. Avoid cramped layouts.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Grid layout for POS (Control Room Grid). Tight gaps (gap-4). Span summary cards across top, data tables span full width below.
spacing_and_layout.customer_menu_grid: Mobile-first bento grid. 1 column for mobile, 2 for tablet. Wide gaps (gap-6 or gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px) - sharp, clean, structural aesthetics resembling traditional Japanese woodworking.

components_strategy.buttons: Flat background. No gradients. primary uses Aka Red (#C93A3E) with white text. Hover: background darkens to #A32A2D, no vertical lift. Use data-testid on all buttons.
components_strategy.cards: Flat background, 1px solid border (#E5E0D8). Very subtle shadow on hover only. No heavy drop shadows.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI inputs. 1px solid border, focus ring in Aka Red (#C93A3E).
components_strategy.tables: Clean, row borders only. No vertical dividers. Ample row padding (py-4).
components_strategy.navigation: Admin: Sidebar with dark Koge Brown background and minimal lucide icons. Customer: Sticky horizontal category list with active state underlined in Aka Red.
components_strategy.badges: Flat background, pill shape (rounded-full). Padding px-3 py-1 text-xs font-semibold.

login_bg.description: High-end minimal Japanese restaurant interior. Use as the background for the Admin Login screen. Must have a black/50 or white/40 overlay for form readability.

washi_texture.description: Subtle washi paper texture. Can be used as a repeating background pattern for the customer menu or admin dashboard body to give organic feel.

qr_scan_prompt.description: QR Code display graphic. Use in the Admin Table Management where the staff generates/prints the QR codes for tables.

menu_sushi.description: Premium sushi placeholder. Use for Main Course / Sushi category items in the customer menu.

menu_ramen.description: Ramen bowl placeholder. Use for Hot Dishes / Main Course items.

menu_matcha.description: Matcha dessert placeholder. Use for Dessert category.

chef_plating.description: Chef plating food. Use as the Hero Image for the customer-facing menu page.

specific_pages_instructions.admin_login: Split layout: left side is the login_bg image covering the pane, right side is the login form. Form must use pure white surface with sharp edges.
specific_pages_instructions.admin_dashboard_layout: Sidebar navigation (dark Koge Brown or Sumi Black background with white text) and a main content area (Shiro White background).
specific_pages_instructions.menu_management: List of menu items with image thumbnails, categories, and JPY price. Use a slide-over (Sheet) or Dialog for Add/Edit menu item. Include upload/image URL field.
specific_pages_instructions.reservations_orders: Dashboard view. Top row: Key metrics (Active Orders, Revenue JPY). Main table: Active orders. Columns: Table Number, Start Time, Finish Time, Total (¥), Items List, Status (Ordered/Paid). Actions: Mark as Paid.
specific_pages_instructions.table_management: Simple view to select a table number and generate a QR code. Display the qr_scan_prompt image gracefully.
specific_pages_instructions.customer_menu_hero: Hero banner at the top showing the chef_plating image, overlaid with elegant serif text welcoming the customer (e.g., 'Table X - Welcome').
specific_pages_instructions.customer_menu_categories: Sticky horizontal scrollable list below hero for categories (Appetizer, Main Course, Dessert, Drinks).
specific_pages_instructions.customer_menu_items: Vertical list or 2-col grid of items. Each item card shows image on left, title/price/description on right, with an elegant 'Add' button.
specific_pages_instructions.customer_cart_checkout: Floating Action Button (FAB) showing item count and total price. Clicking opens a full-screen or slide-up Cart drawer. Cart shows items, allows quantity adjust, and has 'Place Order' CTA. If order exists, 'Add to Order' CTA.
specific_pages_instructions.customer_payment: Once ordered, show order summary. Two buttons for payment: 'Pay via QRIS' (opens a mock QR modal) and 'Pay at Cashier'.

testing_attributes.rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, based on role (e.g., data-testid='admin-login-button', data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='checkout-qris-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use JavaScript (.js or .jsx files), not TypeScript (.ts/.tsx).
Install and use 'date-fns' for formatting datetime fields.
Currency formatting MUST use JPY (¥). Example: new Intl.NumberFormat('ja-JP', { style: 'currency', currency: 'JPY' }).format(price)
Implement JWT auth for admin routes. Protect Admin dashboard layout.
Use mock data initially for the menu if backend is not ready, utilizing the media URLs provided in this JSON.
Build Shadcn UI components manually via generic Tailwind HTML if the CLI fails, or use standard Shadcn installation.
Customer app should read table number from URL params (e.g., /menu?table=5).
